objective: Add action group with requested (list of unique string IDs in desired order) and responses (list of {id:string,ok:bool,value:JSON} when ok=true or {id:string,ok:false,error:string}). For each requested ID, exactly zero or one response is allowed. Reject duplicate requested IDs, unknown response IDs or duplicate responses with ValueError. Return {successes:[{id,value}],failures:[{id,error}],missing:[IDs]}. Every array follows requested order, independent of response arrival order. Missing IDs appear only in missing; falsey successful values (null,false,0,empty string) remain successes. No request is retried or synthesized. Preserve action ids. Shapes/types match this contract. Implement the new action(s) in domain.py, route them through existing api.dispatch(payload), and support them through existing `python cli.py` reading one JSON object from stdin and printing one JSON result. Preserve existing actions, unknown-action ValueError, CLI exit 2 with nonempty stderr/no traceback on ValueError and successful CLI JSON behavior. Never mutate input payloads, including rejected inputs. Assume Python 3.12+ and UTF-8 runtime. Standard library only; all data shapes/types follow the stated contract except explicitly required validation cases. Do not invent additional validation or product policy. Add regression tests and document new usage. Implementation may add helpers/modules but must preserve these public interfaces.
